mapper.update: UPDATE supplier_payment_execution_request SET state_json=#{stateJson},version=#{version},status=#{status},attempts=#{attempts},updated_at=#{updatedAt},next_attempt_at=#{nextAttemptAt},lease_until=#{leaseUntil}, active_authorization_id=#{owner},registered_authorization_id=#{registered} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND input_json=#{inputJson}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM supplier_payment_execution_request WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM supplier_payment_execution_request WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND active_authorization_id=#{authorizationId}
SELECT * FROM supplier_payment_execution_request WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND registered_authorization_id=#{authorizationId}
SELECT * FROM supplier_payment_execution_request WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND authorization_id=#{authorizationId} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT state_json FROM supplier_payment_execution_revision WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND execution_request_id=#{id} AND version=#{version}

SELECT q.tenant_id,q.id,q.trace_id,business.business_no,submitted.process_instance_id FROM supplier_payment_execution_request q LEFT JOIN supplier_payment_authorization origin ON origin.tenant_id=q.tenant_id AND origin.id=q.authorization_id LEFT JOIN approval_application business ON business.tenant_id=q.tenant_id AND business.id=origin.application_id LEFT JOIN approval_submission_round submitted ON submitted.tenant_id=business.tenant_id AND submitted.application_id=business.id AND submitted.round_no=origin.round_no WHERE (q.status='QUEUED' AND q.next_attempt_at<=#{nextAttemptAt}) OR (q.status='RUNNING' AND q.lease_until<=#{leaseUntil}) ORDER BY COALESCE(q.next_attempt_at,q.lease_until),q.created_at,q.id LIMIT 10
SELECT command_json FROM supplier_payment_operation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{authorizationId} AND execution_request_id=#{id} AND execution_request_version=#{version}
